name: Kataude no Zarigani - one-armed crayfish
original_name: 片腕のザリガニ - one-armed crayfish
source:
"Going against the grain? That's just a kind of rebellious phase." That's what high school student Nozaki Yuuta believed, making it his principle to live by going with the flow. And because of that, he spent every day in peace. However, through his classmate Miyoshi Misaki, who went against the grain on absolutely everything, he starts to confront his own true feelings.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3509770/__onearmed_crayfish/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“违背常理？这只是一种叛逆阶段。”高中生野崎雄太也这么认为，顺其自然地生活也是他的原则。也正因为如此，他才安心的度过了每一天。然而，通过他的同学美咲三好，他在一切事情上都与格格不入，他开始面对自己的真实感受。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3509770/__onearmed_crayfish/]Steam[/url]]
